review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked the new definitions (forcedComplexCurve, forcedMildCurve, forcedFourierDissipation, forcedStokesPairing) and searched the CKN directory for competing versions. I did not inspect Mathlib's Fourier or L² API for lemmas that could replace the definitions, because the rubric concerns concept duplication and no definition looked redundant.
